subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's custom extra-bootstrap glob walker and bootstrap hook yielding as the compatibility tradeoff for fixing the embedded_run bootstrap-context stall after the diagnostic timing repair?
rationale: The implementation is focused, but resolver semantics and hook interleaving can affect existing bootstrap context and prompt/session bytes in ways CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept Tested Parity After Timing Fix
options.body: Repair the diagnostic timing issue, then land once required checks pass and maintainers accept the covered glob parity and hook-yield behavior.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a full embedded_run with an active channel or keepalive transcript before accepting the remaining proof gap.

options.title: Broaden Resolver Contract First
options.body: Require additional fs.glob compatibility tests or a different resolver shape before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Tested Parity After Timing Fix
recommendation.body: Repair the diagnostic timing issue, then land once required checks pass and maintainers accept the covered glob parity and hook-yield behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history points to bootstrap read and hook architecture work on the same owner boundary, making this the best available owner for the merge-risk choice.
